exposure: single dose methotrexate regime (50 mg IM)
outcome: successful piecemeal removal of complete placenta accreta
cohort: A primigravida patient with 22-24 weeks intrauterine fetal demise who was diagnosed with Placenta accreta and had no live issue, no active bleeding, and stable vital parameters.
finding: A single dose methotrexate regime followed by piecemeal removal under USG guidance was successful in the conservative management of placenta accreta in a primigravida with intrauterine fetal demise.
gest_age: 22-24 weeks (at time of intrauterine fetal demise)
